decisions.reason: As the successor analytics plugin remains close to the firm's core shop-technology and measurement offering, and management already reaffirmed it in 2024, sunk investment and prior commitment make another year of support more likely than withdrawal.

Although workshops are less central than technical implementation, they were only launched in 2024 and publicly presented on their own page, so management is likely to continue them for now and interpret any weak demand as a temporary ramp-up issue.
